Technical Manual
:::

## System boundary

Stata prepares data, computes measures, applies analytical controls and
publishes approved public packages. Quarto consumes those packages to present
public pages. GitHub deploys the static Info-Hub. Confidential data, private
staging, logs, credentials and review evidence stay outside Git.

## Current workflow map

| Workflow | Steps | Authoritative input | Controlled result |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [CVD event release](cvd-events/overview.qmd) | 6 | Authorised CVD REDCap release | Approved public event metric datasets |
| [CVD mortality release](mortality/overview.qmd) | 6 | Authorised mortality REDCap release | Approved public mortality metric datasets |
| [Rolling three-month update](reporting/rolling-update.qmd) | 1 | Exact approved event and mortality release CSVs | Dated, versioned online update package |
| [Annual CVD report](reporting/annual-report.qmd) | 3 | Approved standard releases plus year-specific analyst files | Approved PDF and landing-page package |
| [One-off CVD report](reporting/one-off-report.qmd) | 3 | Finished bespoke PDF | Approved PDF and landing-page package |

The event and mortality workflows remain separate. Public CVD tables,
dashboards and downloads are website views of approved metric releases; they
do not rerun or redefine the analysis.

## Control pattern

- Build candidates in private locations.
- Run automated validation and complete human analytical and disclosure review.
- Bind approval to the exact reviewed payload where required.
- Publish only through the workflow's publication action.
- Let Quarto read approved public outputs only.
- Correct source data or version-controlled code, then rerun; never patch a
  generated output.

The rolling update is deliberately narrower: the builder verifies and freezes
already-approved public event and mortality releases and the controlled
template performs only authorised display arithmetic.

## Responsibilities

The **BNR Analyst** runs and reviews analysis, the **BNR Lead** holds operational
and governance responsibility, and the **BNR Developer** maintains the
analytical and publication implementation. An authorised person may perform
more than one action, but build, review, approval, publication and deployment
remain distinct recorded actions.
